_note: canonical: Cloudflare-proxied CNAME onto the B2 bucket lp-rexdalemobilewash-img.
allow: empty on purpose. Every entry is a hotlink with permission — if the
image is the client's, it belongs in the bucket, not in this list.
oldHost is not the bare hostname, and both halves of that matter.
The leading // is required: without it the string is a substring of
//img-lp.rexdalemobilewash.ca and every page reports as a hit.
The /wp-content/uploads suffix is required because lp.rexdalemobilewash.ca
is BOTH the WordPress host being migrated off and this site's own future
address, so every canonical link would otherwise be reported. The upload
path is the part that dies when the old site is switched off.
